messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Atlasica monthly cost triage tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need a short spend forecast, top token-heavy flows, and an enablement snippet for their infra team. Who can take ownership of the forecast + mitigation bullets?

ashley_se: I9ll take the spend forecast. Can someone paste the last 90d token & embed volumes (hourly or daily agg). Looking for recent bump windows and steady-state baseline.

raj_engineer: Noted spike after conversion rollout. I9ll run a quick query to extract top endpoints and median tokens/calls. Quick infra query I9m running: 

```
# tokens per endpoint for account=atlasica last 90d
SELECT endpoint, count(*) as calls, percentile(tokens, 50) as median_tokens, sum(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM request_logs
WHERE account = 'atlasica' AND time > now() - 90d
GROUP BY endpoint
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
```

Use `--org atlasica` for multi-tenant backups.

jamie_finops: Billing export snapshot: their committed credits cover ~58% of run-rate today. At current trend they exhaust buffer in ~16-20 days. Proposal for alerts: warn @ 65%, ops notif @ 85%, billing soft-cap @ 95%. Recommend we offer a one-time 12% uplift on their commit to avoid churn risk. Thoughts?

oliver_csm: I9ll prep a 10-minute enablement demo focused on prompt trims, KV/session cache tips, and an example of proactive throttling. Can someone supply top 4 high-cost prompts so I can build side-by-side "before/after" callouts?

ashley_se: I'll include 3 forecast scenarios (baseline, adoption surge, worst-case) + recommended trigger thresholds for throttles and alerts. ETA: today EOD.

raj_engineer: From a quick pass: endpoints ranked by cost are:
- /checkout/generate (median 1,200 tokens)
- /batch-embeds (median 850 tokens, bursty)
- /session-resume (KV fetches + long context)
- /report/export (periodic heavy exports)
I'll upload a CSV with hourly series and annotated peak windows.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: atlasica/feature/conv-flow-v3 @ 2024-11-14T22:12:09Z :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Great. Action items:
- ashley_se: spend forecast slides (2 slides: headline + mitigation) [owner]
- raj_engineer: top endpoints CSV + median tokens (upload before EOD) [owner]
- jamie_finops: create Console alert rules based on thresholds once ashley publishes scenarios [owner]
- oliver_csm: enablement demo + 1-pager runbook + feedback capture slide (before account check-in) [owner]

jamie_finops: I9ll also provision billing-export access to ashley. If we agree on the 12% uplift, I can prepare a commit amendment and pricing note to present in the QBR.

ashley_se: No blockers from me. I9ll call out cost per 1k tokens and embed unit economics in the slides.

oliver_csm: I9ll reserve a 15-20 minute slot after the QBR for the live demo and leave time for feedback capture (quick three-question poll).

maria_cs: Perfect. If no objections I9ll update the QBR doc and ping for review at 4:30pm PT.

ashley_se: Sounds good 44d

raj_engineer: CSV uploaded to channel: atlasica-top-endpoints-90d.csv.

jamie_finops: Done — billing access granted to ashley_se.

maria_cs: Thanks team. We'll present forecast + mitigation + alert gating during the account check-in tomorrow. Please flag any late blockers here. :rocket:
